item.title: Strip of tarmac broken up leaving a large gap in road, 5th October
item.description:
This section of the road is dangerous to pedestrians and cars. A large section of the tarmac has lifted from one side of the road to the other just before Chandler Road, Loughton. When the lights go out at 1am you could quite easily brake your ankle and fall down. The cars crossing over this is keeping the residents awake at night. I have seen a couple of cars burst their tyres. Urgent repair is required on the road before Chandler Road, Loughton. I look forward to an update as to when this will fixed
Report on FixMyStreet
